manual_notes: A merged commit proves repository history, not Outcome Owner acceptance.
A local feature-slice accepted status is distinct from a product-domain Target reconstructed as accepted.
Runtime observations were read-only; T001 changed no historical target record or database fact.
Direct execution was used because T001 is a bounded artifact-only audit and subagent delegation was neither requested nor authorized.

residual_risks: Historical live facts in deleted development workspaces cannot be re-probed and remain historical evidence only.
Some accepted feature-slice records can be misread as product-domain Target acceptance until T002 adds explicit status scope.
T001 does not repair records or implement missing contracts; it only defines the evidence-backed boundary for later tasks.
